metadata.title: Scale-invariant bounds on thin sets for measures satisfying a first-order PDE and the anisotropic Michael-Simon inequality
metadata.abstract: We prove mass estimates for PDE-constrained measures on sets of $\sigma$-finite ${\mathcal H}^m$-measure, assuming an appropriate rank condition. As an application, we derive a Michael--Simon inequality for varifolds with bounded anisotropic first variation with respect to an integrand that satisfies the natural atomic condition (AC1).

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: PDE 约束测度与各向异性 Sobolev 界
analysis.workSummary: 在适当秩条件下，估计受一阶 PDE 约束测度在 σ 有限 Hm 集上的质量；应用于满足 AC1 原子条件的各向异性第一变分有界 varifold。
analysis.breakthrough: 把薄集质量控制转化为各向异性 Michael–Simon 型工具。
analysis.limitations: 秩与 AC1 条件不可省略；不涵盖任意各向异性 integrand。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.priorityReason: 为几何测度论与各向异性变分问题提供基础估计。
